title: Cryo chambers on Mars
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Cryo chambers on Mars, about ancient at Mars, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they did report that there were cryo chambers on Mars and that there were people who had been left there

plain: A researcher and philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025, relays something he credits to a man named Joe McMoneagle. According to Jorjani, it was reported that there were cryo chambers, places for keeping bodies frozen, on Mars, and that people had been left there. If true, it would mean someone had been on Mars long before us.
